title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Fraze Pavilion, Kettering | 2024
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Fraze Pavilion in Kettering, Ohio, USA, on 15 September 2024.

It was the 18th show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s 2024 tour.

Starr had previously performed at the Fraze Pavilion on 8 July 2008, 2 July 2014, and 11 September 2018.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

  • ‘Matchbox’
  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘Rosanna’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Pick Up The Pieces’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘Down Under’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Boys’

  • ‘Photograph’

  • ‘Give Peace A Chance’
